title: Endpoint Network Containment
details: Simulated 802.1X VLAN isolation applied to endpoint 'WS-ENGINEERING-07'. Blocked all ingress/egress traffic except SOC telemetry port 8443.
mitigation_impact: Halts lateral propagation and prevents attacker C2 egress.
